title: Count scheduled runs over 48 hours and report
goal: Know whether the hourly schedule fires as configured
acceptance: Scheduled runs of refresh-views.yml and maintenance.yml counted over 48 h, and those of one sibling repository's scheduled workflow, with the commands used
The record says whether the schedule fires as configured; if not, the options (accept, another minute, another trigger) go to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: gh run listings and a short note. Not a measurement.

privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
